reason: Both reach the correct verdict (fix, don't kill, don't scale) with accurate math. A adds actionable points that B lacks: landing pages matched to intent clusters, the Smart Bidding data-starvation insight, pruning PMax/Display/Search Partners, weekly negatives, and the annual-prepay cash-flow math. B has crisper kill criteria and a useful check on whether ads-acquired customers churn faster, but it omits landing-page and intent-tier fixes. Neither mentions content/SEO as an alternative use of the budget. A edges ahead on coverage of the key points.
